description: Reads hardcoded (burned-in) video subtitles, also known as hardsubs, aloud in real time using the high-accuracy Windows 11 OneOCR engine, with automatic fallback to legacy Windows OCR. Press NVDA+alt+shift+s to toggle. Configure in NVDA Settings, HardSub Reader category.
changelog:
* Added noise filtering: a list of phrases or patterns that are never read aloud.
* Choose from built-in options (timestamps, ALL-CAPS watermarks, ad-skip prompts, symbol-only misreads) or type your own phrases.
* Custom phrases match a whole subtitle line exactly, so they cannot accidentally remove dialogue that merely contains the same words.
* Advanced: start a line with `regex:` to use a regular expression instead of plain text.
